data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is delighted to present this exquisitely furnished studio apartment in the highly anticipated Skyhills Astra, a futuristic development rising in Dubai Science Park. Ideally located just minutes from Dubai Hills Estate and directly connected to the metro station, this project promises unmatched convenience and connectivity.

Key Features:

Spacious Studio Layout
Fully Furnished with High-End Finishes
Integrated Smart Home System
Iconic Views of Burj Khalifa & Dubai Skyline
Private Sandy Beach & Longest Tracking Path in Dubai
Mall Within the Community for Everyday Convenience
50+ Amenities: Pools, Fitness Centers, Co-working Spaces, Wellness Zones & More
Direct Metro Access for Seamless Connectivity
Minutes from Dubai Hills Estate and Al Khail Road
High ROI Potential in a Rapidly Growing Area
Ideal for Investors & End Users Alike
Unique, Flexible Payment Plan:
0.5% Monthly Until Completion
1% Monthly for 3 Years Post-Handover
60/40 Overall Payment Structure – Designed for Optimized Cash Flow
Estimated Handover: December 2027

About the Project:
Skyhills Astra is more than a residence — it’s a lifestyle-focused, master-planned community offering the perfect blend of innovation, luxury, and value. With futuristic design elements, integrated smart tech, and an amenity-rich environment, it is set to become one of Dubai’s most iconic addresses. Whether you're a savvy investor or a homeowner seeking modern urban living, this opportunity is not to be missed.
